rules.question: Does this change make a Leash command exit non-zero, throw, or block the agent when the API key is missing, the rubric is missing, or a Jev call fails, instead of staying silent and letting the agent continue?
Does this change add or grow a function that does more than one job, so that an honest name for it would need the word 'and'?
Does this change add an abstraction (interface, wrapper, base class, options object) that has only one implementation or one caller?
Does this change catch an error and discard it without surfacing it anywhere (no log line, no skipped-list entry, no rethrow, no comment explaining why)?
rules.source: check.ts: failures are reported as [skipped], never silently

rules.question: Is any line longer than the project's 120-character limit?
